title: Ran a three-day GenAI workshop that lifted confidence 69%
summary: An engineering team's leaders invited me to Plymouth, Minnesota, for three days of hands-on GenAI work; the team's confidence in using AI rose from 4.5 to 7.6 out of 10.
what_would_have_happened: The team would keep using AI tentatively, as a chatbot.
the_call: Teach hands-on, with exercises, and make sure no one is left behind.
what_i_did: Taught prompt and context engineering, spec-driven development and AI for requirements, and measured confidence before and after.
what_changed: Measured confidence rose 69%, and the team reported a significant rise in Copilot use after the training.
